part: final-a days 1-5 (Tokyo, Kawasaki, car days to Fuji, Mishima -> Nara) + flights into Japan (and the return flights on Google Flights)

issues.problem: Toyota Rent a Car takes bookings 6 months ahead, not 3 months: the Jan 21 car can already be booked now, and waiting to Oct 21 risks losing the few studless-tyre cars.
issues.evidence: https://rent.toyota.co.jp/static/inquiry/faq/reserve (FAQ: 出発日の6ヶ月前からご予約いただけます; the app FAQ says the same)
issues.fix: Change the bookFirst line to 'book now (bookings open 6 months ahead)'. Pick studless tyres and ETC in the booking and phone the shop (044-211-0100) to confirm a studless car.

issues.problem: In Kanagawa, studless tyres are an option (¥2,200 per 24 h) with a limited number of cars ('車種や台数に限りがございます'); the shop page does not say this shop has them.
issues.fix: Book now and get the studless tyres confirmed in writing. If the shop has none, use another Toyota Rent-Lease Yokohama shop near Kawasaki Station or keep chains in the car.

issues.item: Enoshima hour with the Slam Dunk crossing
issues.problem: From the island car park to Enoden Enoshima Station is about 15–20 min on foot each way, and trains run every 12 min: the bridge, the shrine gate and the Kamakurakokomae crossing need about 1 h 30, not 1 h, so Taikanzan at 11:20 slips to about 11:45.
issues.evidence: OSRM free-flow drive Enoshima -> Taikanzan 68 min (router.project-osrm.org), longer than the plan's 1 h 05 ; Enoden map
issues.fix: Park at a coin car park near Enoden Enoshima / Katase instead of on the island, or drop the island walk and do only the crossing; allow 1 h 20 for Enoshima -> Taikanzan (lounge is open weekdays 09:30–16:00, so lunch still works).

issues.item: Shinjuku -> Enoshima at 07:40 on a Friday
issues.problem: Free-flow time is 70 min for 55 km; with Friday morning traffic on Shuto Route 3 and Route 467 it is more likely 1 h 30–1 h 45, so arrival is about 09:15–09:25.
issues.fix: Leave at 07:15, or accept the later start and shorten Enoshima.

issues.problem: To reach Shinjuku-sanchome at 18:36 he must be on the 17:19 train, only 49 min after landing, which includes immigration at the busy afternoon peak; the next options arrive 18:56–19:11, so Uniqlo and the 19:15 Isetan meeting (food hall closes 20:00) overlap.
issues.fix: Go straight to Isetan (meet 19:15–19:30) and do Uniqlo after Omoide Yokocho: Uniqlo Shinjuku Honten is open to 22:00 and is 3 min from Isetan.

issues.item: Aoki: Narita 13:40 -> Suga stairs 16:45 by limousine bus
issues.problem: After immigration (about 14:40) the bus to Shinjuku plus the hotel stop and the subway gives about 17:00 or later at Suga, after the 16:52 sunset; the train is faster (Narita T1 14:59 -> Shinjuku-sanchome 16:14).
issues.evidence: https://www.jorudan.co.jp/norikae/ (Narita T1 -> Shinjuku-sanchome, 14:45–15:09 departures, 1 h 15–1 h 35)
issues.fix: Use the Keisei Skyliner/Access Express + subway (about ¥1,500–3,000) instead of the bus, or accept the stairs at dusk.

issues.problem: The flight is listed for Jan 19, 2027 but Google Flights shows 'Price unavailable', so the CA$376 fare cannot be confirmed now.
issues.fix: If Air China cannot be booked, take China Southern 09:15 -> 13:15 (CA$354) or Juneyao 08:25 -> 12:00; the day plan still works.

issues.problem: Police closures now also happen on weekdays (a driver reported closures about 3 nights a week in April 2026), so 'low on Thursday' is not certain.
issues.fix: Keep the plan, but check X and the Shutoko closure site at 18:00; if closed, go to Tatsumi 1st PA directly and allow 35–40 min for the drive Daikoku -> Tatsumi (the plan says 25 min).

issues.problem: Winter hours (Dec–Feb) are 10:00–19:00, not 10:00–20:00; the plan's 13:40–15:15 visit is not affected.
Recent shows start between 18:45 and 19:30 (e.g. OPEN 18:15 / START 18:45), so 'start about 19:30' may be late.
issues.fix: When you buy the ticket, set the Shimokitazawa walk and dinner to end 15 min before OPEN.

issues.problem: The campsite lists a car fee of ¥600 per car; it is not clear if short visitors pay it.
